groups.title: Frontend Core
groups.unlocks: Interactive, type-safe web interfaces that hold up under refactoring — component boundaries drawn where they belong, not where a tutorial stopped.

groups.title: UI & Styling
groups.tagline: Looks that load fast and hold together.
groups.unlocks: Mobile-first layouts that stay consistent when the content team keeps adding words. Animation that adds context, not noise.

groups.title: Backend & Databases
groups.tagline: The part underneath that makes it real.
groups.unlocks: APIs designed for the frontend that consumes them — schema first, migrations committed, errors that mean something when they hit the client.

groups.title: Firebase Stack
groups.unlocks: Startups and MVPs can skip the DevOps budget — auth, data and logic as platform primitives. Security rules written before the first user signs up.
groups.proof: Chat, notifications and storage pipelines in live apps.

groups.title: Mobile Development
groups.unlocks: Apps that share logic with their web counterpart. Push notifications, offline storage and release builds configured from the start, not hacked in later.

groups.title: DevOps & Shipping
groups.unlocks: Releases that don't depend on one developer's laptop. Push to main, watch it deploy — with secrets handled properly and rollback within reach.
groups.proof: Pipelines across client work and side projects.

groups.title: AI Integration
groups.unlocks: Chat assistants, smart summaries and suggestion features wired into real interfaces. Prompts as versioned code, cost tracked like any other dependency.
groups.proof: Project work in this year alone.
